# Browser Dependencies

These files are served locally. Opening the workbench does not fetch scripts from a CDN.

| Package | Version | Browser File | License File |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lucide | 1.57.0 | lucide.min.js | lucide.LICENSE |
| Marked | 18.1.1 | marked.umd.js | marked.LICENSE |
| DOMPurify | 3.4.17 | purify.min.js | DOMPurify.LICENSE |

Sources: the corresponding pinned npm packages, obtained through jsDelivr.

- https://www.npmjs.com/package/lucide/v/1.57.0
- https://www.npmjs.com/package/marked/v/18.1.1
- https://www.npmjs.com/package/dompurify/v/3.4.17

Lucide provides the icons. Marked parses model answers as Markdown. DOMPurify sanitizes the resulting HTML before rendering it.
